title: Review of c26's RPS Lenia small domains: 128^2 replicates (seed 3 keeps 3 kinds at 7-15 cells), but at 96^2 a kind is lost after founding (seed 4, kind 0 at 9 cells by t=170, gone at t=260) and another seed falls to 1 cell; at 64^2 2/2 seeds lose a kind (t=60, 240). The data point to a coexistence threshold near 96^2, not its absence
summary: c26's world and counter, cyclic mode, t=0-800, new seeds. 128^2 seed 3: all three kinds, means 10-14 cells over t>=400, minima 7-8. 96^2: seed 5 keeps all three (minima 5-6); seed 3 keeps all three but kinds 0 and 2 fall to 1 cell after t=400 (means 6.2/8.4/3.3); seed 4 loses kind 0 at t=260 after it had grown to 9 cells (arms/c96_s4.png), so the loss is not a founding artefact. 64^2: seed 3 loses kind 0 at t=60 (founding), seed 4 loses kind 1 at t=240. A labkit pack at 96^2 (seed 6, t=0-400) has all three kinds dividing (4-6 persistent splits each, generation 2-4).

observations.X: arms/c128_s3.png: three kinds coexist at 128^2; arms/c96_s4.png: kind 0 (red) grows to 9 cells then is eaten out by t=260 at 96^2

seeds_run.result: 128^2 pass; 96^2 pass but two kinds at 1 cell; 64^2 kind lost at t=60
96^2 FAIL for the claim: kind 0 lost at t=260 after founding; 64^2 kind lost at t=240
96^2 labkit pack to t=400: three kinds persist and divide

verdicts.limitation: 128^2 replicates. At 96^2 the claim that the only loss is a founding artefact does not hold: 1 of 3 new seeds loses a kind well after founding and 1 nearly does; with c26's runs, 96^2 keeps all kinds in 3 of 5 runs, and 64^2 in 0 of 2. That is a gradual threshold between 64^2 and 128^2, contrary to the title's 'no threshold in 96-160^2'. Counts use c26's >= 20 px core components, so a minimum of 1 may hide sub-threshold matter.
